Bill Hagerty

Republican candidate for United States Senate, Tennessee · Incumbent

U.S. Senator from Tennessee (incumbent)

Bill Hagerty is the incumbent Republican U.S. Senator from Tennessee and is running for re-election in 2026 instead of running for governor. He won the August 2026 Republican primary unopposed, receiving 629,194 votes. He serves on the Senate Foreign Relations, Appropriations, and Banking Committees.

Where Hagerty stands

Cryptocurrency / stablecoin regulation
Sponsored the GENIUS Act to set a federal regulatory framework for payment stablecoins. He says the framework protects consumers, promotes innovation, and modernizes U.S. payment systems.
Immigration
Introduced a bill to end federal housing assistance for immigrants who are in the country illegally.
Disaster relief
Joined the Tennessee congressional delegation in September 2026 in urging President Trump to quickly approve Governor Bill Lee's request for a Major Disaster Declaration after severe weather in West Tennessee.
